newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to allow foreigners to buy convertible debs.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to allow foreigners to buy convertible debs.

text.p: Foreign investors will be allowed to purchase debentures convertible into shares through the Annex Four rules for non-Brazilian investments, Central Bank director Gustavo Franco said.
Investors would be able to buy debentures issued as of November 1 that have a minimum maturity of three years, Franco said.

The Brazilian government last year restricted foreign investment in debentures after an "explosive" influx of foreign investment, using the investment as an alternative to fixed-income funds from which they were banned.
The decision was approved at a meeting of the National Monetary (CMN) late Wednesday.
